limitations: All graph and intermediate partition counts here describe the baseline, not variant execution. Their association with remaining misses motivates investigation, not causal proof.
An initial graph edge is not an orthology certificate; component retention could still overmerge paralogs and worsen functional similarity.
The component hypothesis is not yet an accepted parameter change, measured improvement or promoted default.
next_actions: Finish and independently admit live QfO large-only and medium-only endpoint vectors and the fresh HMM cap panel, including queued scoring recovery. No duplicate inference.
Use those results plus complete-cohort eligibility/coherence diagnosis to prespecify and implement one component-preserving mechanism test if justified; do not expand caps or hide failed endpoints.
Compare the full eight-endpoint vector, precision/recall/coverage/pairs and resource scopes against matched controls and OrthoFinder 3.1.5 full pipeline before promotion.
Keep existing OrthoBench/GO regression rejection and unexposed-confirmation requirements intact.

proposed_next_mechanism_hypothesis.motivation: Broad-mode large-copy refinement currently singletonizes entire eligible clusters. Compare retaining strong HMM/RBNH-supported components as candidates for duplication-aware native gene trees, not as final ortholog cliques.
proposed_next_mechanism_hypothesis.name: bounded_hmm_supported_component_preserving_large_copy_refinement
proposed_safeguards: Keep behavior opt-in and retain the unchanged published control.
Preserve complete gene universe, singleton/fragment/isolated-gene handling and deterministic partitions.
Retain components only within the unchanged 500-gene bound; do not infer orthology from connectedness.
Require HMM high-sensitivity candidate inference and native duplication-aware phylogenetic reconciliation; preserve species-overlap/paralogy evidence.
Hold unrelated search, expansion, species/root/pair and satellite settings fixed in the first component ablation.
required_preimplementation_diagnosis: Join actual executed copy-splitting eligibility predicates to the complete trace, with the numeric checkpoint gene order. Distinguish bound-limited, eligible, inactive and other refinement cases without selecting reference families.
Validate component-edge score semantics against the actual directed RBNH inputs used by refinement; saved undirected graph weights cannot be silently substituted.
Measure label-blind family/component size, species/copy structure and sequence/alignment coherence across all eligible families, not only reference errors.
